# Optick

**Optick** is a super-lightweight C++ profiler for Games.

## Download Sources & Binaries

- **Site**: https://microsoft.github.io/mimalloc/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/bombomby/optick

## Update Rules

1. Update sources (`src/`).
2. Update all binaries (`bin/` and `lib/`).
3. Update all header files (`include/`).
4. Verify compatibility with the project.
5. Update the README (version, download links, etc).

## Version

1.4.0
